market.question: Will the highest temperature in Singapore be 33°C on May 5?

assessment.reasoning: Singapore Met Service first-fortnight May outlook calls for daily highs of 33-35°C with afternoon thunder showers. Climatology for Changi puts mean high 31-32°C but recent forecast skew is 33-35. Resolution YES if exact daytime high lands at 33°C — within the most-probable forecast bucket.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether thundershowers cap the day at 32 vs allow 33 vs 34/35.
